tapeout: A student seated at a probe station in a lab, peering through a microscope at a freshly fabricated silicon chip whose die is held under fine metal probe needles. One callout panel shows the die itself as a tidy grid of circuit blocks, next to the round wafer it was cut from. A second callout shows an oscilloscope screen with a clean measured waveform, the key result traced in the accent colour.
vehicle: A small team of students on a closed test track beside a real test car with a LiDAR unit on its roof; one student kneels at a tripod-mounted laser device aimed at the car while another watches a laptop on a folding table. One callout shows the car's point-cloud view with a false obstacle appearing ahead, drawn in the accent colour. A second callout shows the tripod device's emitter up close.
world: A student presenting on stage in a large international conference hall, a wide projection screen behind them showing a simple diagram, and an audience of researchers of many backgrounds in rows of seats. One callout shows a stylised globe with arcs linking Japan to North America, Europe and China. A second callout shows two researchers talking in front of a poster board.
media: A single research illustration of a LiDAR car at the centre, radiating outward onto a tablet news page, a smartphone feed and an open printed magazine spread, each showing the same small picture. One callout shows a small camera crew with a microphone interviewing a student in the lab beside the equipment.
onboarding: A friendly study session around a lab table: senior students guiding new members through a whiteboard sketch that pairs a circuit schematic with a small neural network, laptops open and notebooks on the table. One callout shows a staircase of blocks rising from a single simple gate up to a complete chip at the top. A second callout shows a breadboard with a few components and a soldering iron.
resources: A well-equipped lab corner: a rack of FPGA boards, a tower GPU server, a LiDAR sensor on a mount and a shelf of measurement instruments. One callout shows a small parcel opened to reveal a packaged chip freshly delivered from a foundry. A second callout shows an aeroplane arcing along a dashed path toward a distant conference venue with a few buildings.
